sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Ivory Coast visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa for Côte d’Ivoire (Ivory Coast). For air arrivals, you complete an online pre-registration and pay before you travel, then the visa is issued when you arrive at the airport in Abidjan.

sections.heading: Ivory Coast visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually follow the same process. Keep your pre-registration approval to show at check-in and on arrival.

sections.heading: Ivory Coast visa: what to have ready
sections.text: You'll usually need your passport, a recent photo, your flight booking, details of where you'll stay or an invitation, and proof of yellow fever vaccination. We complete the online pre-registration and check your documents first.

sections.heading: Ivory Coast visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Ivory Coast visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Côte d’Ivoire.

faqs.q: Do British citizens need a visa for Ivory Coast?
faqs.a: Yes. You pre-register online and pay before you travel, and the visa is issued when you arrive at Abidjan airport.

faqs.q: Do I need a yellow fever certificate for Ivory Coast?
faqs.a: Yes, proof of yellow fever vaccination is normally required for entry.

faqs.q: How long does a Ivory Coast visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
